subject: english
title: Prefixes pre- and mis-
canDo: I can use pre-, mis- and other prefixes to work out and change what a word means.

subject: english
title: Suffixes -ness and -ment
canDo: I can add -ness or -ment to make a noun and spell it correctly.

subject: english
title: Plurals with -ves and irregular plurals
titleId: Bentuk jamak -ves dan jamak tidak beraturan
canDo: I can spell tricky plurals such as leaves, ponies, children and sheep.

subject: english
title: Root words and word families
canDo: I can find the root word in a longer word and use word families to work out meanings.

subject: english
title: Past progressive and present perfect
canDo: I can use was or were with an -ing verb, and has or have with a past form.

subject: english
title: Making subjects and verbs agree
canDo: I can make the verb match the person or thing doing it, for one or more than one.

subject: english
title: Similes and describing words
canDo: I can understand similes that use like or as, and choose ones that fit what I describe.

subject: english
title: Adverbs, prepositions and fronted adverbials
titleId: Kata keterangan, preposisi, dan keterangan di awal kalimat
canDo: I can say how, when and where with adverbs and phrases, and put a comma after a fronted adverbial.

subject: english
title: Conjunctions and complex sentences
canDo: I can join a main clause to another clause with words like although, while, until and unless.

subject: english
title: Apostrophes to show belonging
canDo: I can use an apostrophe to show that something belongs to one owner or to more than one.

subject: english
title: Fact and opinion
canDo: I can tell the difference between a fact that can be checked and an opinion that someone thinks.

subject: english
title: Inference and evidence
titleId: Menyimpulkan dan mencari bukti dalam teks
canDo: I can work out what characters feel and why things happen, and find words in the text that show it.

subject: english
title: Paragraphs, text structure and the writer's choices
titleId: Paragraf, struktur teks, dan pilihan kata penulis
canDo: I can explain how a text is organised into paragraphs and sections, and why the writer chose some words.

subject: english
title: Writing persuasive letters and reports
canDo: I can write a polite letter that gives reasons to persuade, and a report organised with subheadings.

subject: english
title: Discussing and presenting
canDo: I can share my opinion with reasons, listen to others and agree or disagree politely.
